import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Users, Award, Plus, ArrowRight, Forward, Smartphone, Star, CheckCircle, Download, CheckCircle2, RotateCcw,
  Copy, ShieldCheck, Phone, MapPin, Sparkles, AlertCircle, Building2, UserCheck, Inbox, Clock
} from 'lucide-react';
import { dbService } from '../services/dbService';
import { firestoreService } from '../services/firestoreService';
import { AdminLead, AssociateAccount, FirestoreCollections } from '../types';
import { orderBy, limit } from 'firebase/firestore';

interface AssociateDashboardProps {
  loggedInUser?: string | null;
  onShowToast?: (msg: string) => void;
  onNavigatePublic?: () => void;
}

interface Lead {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  phone: string;
  interestedVenture: string;
  budget: string;
  date?: string;
  sourceNote?: string;
  completedDate?: string;
}

export const AssociateDashboard: React.FC<AssociateDashboardProps> = ({
  loggedInUser,
  onShowToast,
}) => {
  const [currentAssociate, setCurrentAssociate] = useState<AssociateAccount | null>(null);
  const [isLoadingProfile, setIsLoadingProfile] = useState(true);
  const [copiedCode, setCopiedCode] = useState(false);

  // Direct client pipeline registered by this ASC
  const [leads, setLeads] = useState<Lead[]>([]);

  // Completed / Closed deals archive
  const [completedLeads, setCompletedLeads] = useState<Lead[]>([]);

  // General inquiries forwarded to THIS specific ASC by Head Office Admin
  const [adminForwardedLeads, setAdminForwardedLeads] = useState<Lead[]>([]);

  const [directViewMode, setDirectViewMode] = useState<'active' | 'completed'>('active');

  // Form inputs
  const [newLeadName, setNewLeadName] = useState('');
  const [newLeadPhone, setNewLeadPhone] = useState('');
  const [newLeadVenture, setNewLeadVenture] = useState('Royal City (Shadnagar)');

  // 1. Resolve the Associate Profile dynamically from Firestore
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    async function loadAssociateProfile() {
      setIsLoadingProfile(true);
      const identifier = (loggedInUser || '').trim();

      if (!identifier) {
        // Fallback for default demo associate if no session provided
        try {
          const fallback = await firestoreService.findAssociateByIdentifier('SVS-ASC-441');
          if (isMounted) setCurrentAssociate(fallback);
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('Error fetching demo associate:', e);
        } finally {
          if (isMounted) setIsLoadingProfile(false);
        }
        return;
      }

      try {
        const profile = await firestoreService.findAssociateByIdentifier(identifier);
        if (isMounted && profile) {
          setCurrentAssociate(profile);
        } else if (isMounted) {
          // If newly registered or code-based fallback
          const isCode = identifier.startsWith('SVS-ASC');
          setCurrentAssociate({
            id: identifier,
            associateCode: isCode ? identifier : `SVS-ASC-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`,
            name: !isCode ? identifier : 'Associate Partner',
            phone: '',
            email: '',
            city: 'Telangana & AP',
            status: 'Active',
            commissionRate: 'Standard Tier (Direct Allocation)',
            activeReferrals: 0,
            completedDeals: 0,
            totalEarnings: 0,
            registeredDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
          });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Error loading associate profile:', err);
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) setIsLoadingProfile(false);
      }
    }

    loadAssociateProfile();
    return () => { isMounted = false; };
  }, [loggedInUser]);

  // Keep associate profile synced with real-time updates (e.g. commission changes by Admin)
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsub = firestoreService.listenAssociates((list) => {
      const activeIdentifier = (currentAssociate?.associateCode || loggedInUser || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!activeIdentifier) return;

      const match = list.find((a) => 
        (a.associateCode && a.associateCode.toLowerCase() === activeIdentifier) ||
        (a.id && a.id.toLowerCase() === activeIdentifier) ||
        (a.phone && a.phone.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') === activeIdentifier.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')) ||
        (a.name && a.name.toLowerCase() === activeIdentifier)
      );

      if (match) {
        setCurrentAssociate(match);
      }
    });
    return () => unsub();
  }, [currentAssociate?.associateCode, loggedInUser]);

  // Derive active identifiers for this associate
  const activeCode = currentAssociate?.associateCode || (loggedInUser?.startsWith('SVS-ASC') ? loggedInUser : 'SVS-ASC-441');
  const activeName = currentAssociate?.name || (!loggedInUser?.startsWith('SVS-ASC') ? loggedInUser : 'Associate Partner') || 'Associate Partner';

  // 2. Fetch real leads strictly scoped to THIS associate's code or phone
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeCode) return;

    const normalizedCode = activeCode.toLowerCase().trim();
    const phoneDigits = currentAssociate?.phone ? currentAssociate.phone.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') : '';

    const unsubscribe = dbService.subscribeToCollection<AdminLead>(
      FirestoreCollections.LEADS,
      (allLeads) => {
        const myDirect: Lead[] = [];
        const myDone: Lead[] = [];
        const forwarded: Lead[] = [];

        allLeads.forEach((l) => {
          const leadAssocCode = (l.formData && l.formData['Associate Code']) 
            ? String(l.formData['Associate Code']).toLowerCase().trim() 
            : '';
          const leadAssocMobile = (l.formData && l.formData['Associate Mobile']) 
            ? String(l.formData['Associate Mobile']).replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') 
            : '';
          const notesText = (l.notes || '').toLowerCase();
          const sourceText = (l.source || '').toLowerCase();
          const assignedToCode = (l.assignedTo || '').toLowerCase().trim();
          const formDataAssigned = (l.formData && l.formData['Assigned Associate']) 
            ? String(l.formData['Assigned Associate']).toLowerCase().trim() 
            : '';

          // 1. Direct ownership: lead registered by this associate
          const isDirectOwnership = 
            (leadAssocCode && leadAssocCode === normalizedCode) ||
            notesText.includes(normalizedCode) ||
            sourceText.includes(normalizedCode) ||
            (phoneDigits && leadAssocMobile && leadAssocMobile === phoneDigits);

          // 2. Head Office forwarding: lead assigned explicitly to this associate
          const isAssignedByAdmin = 
            (assignedToCode && assignedToCode === normalizedCode) ||
            (formDataAssigned && formDataAssigned === normalizedCode) ||
            notesText.includes(`assigned to ${normalizedCode}`) ||
            notesText.includes(`forwarded to ${normalizedCode}`);

          const item: Lead = {
            id: l.id,
            name: l.name,
            phone: l.phone,
            interestedVenture: l.service || l.venture || 'SVS Venture',
            budget: (l.formData && l.formData['Budget Range']) || '',
            date: l.createdAt ? new Date(l.createdAt).toLocaleDateString() : 'Recent',
            completedDate: l.status === 'Completed' || l.status === 'Registered' ? (l.formData?.['Completed Date'] || 'Completed') : undefined,
            sourceNote: isAssignedByAdmin ? 'Assigned by Head Office' : 'Direct Registration'
          };

          if (isDirectOwnership) {
            if (l.status === 'Completed' || l.status === 'Registered') {
              myDone.push(item);
            } else {
              myDirect.push(item);
            }
          } else if (isAssignedByAdmin) {
            if (l.status === 'Completed' || l.status === 'Registered') {
              myDone.push(item);
            } else {
              forwarded.push(item);
            }
          }
          // Any other lead belongs to another associate or is unassigned public enquiry — strictly excluded!
        });

        setLeads(myDirect);
        setCompletedLeads(myDone);
        setAdminForwardedLeads(forwarded);
      },
      [orderBy('timestamp', 'desc'), limit(100)]
    );

    return () => unsubscribe();
  }, [activeCode, currentAssociate?.phone]);

  const handleCopyCode = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(activeCode);
    setCopiedCode(true);
    if (onShowToast) onShowToast(`Copied Associate Code ${activeCode} to clipboard!`);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedCode(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleAddLead = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newLeadName.trim() || !newLeadPhone.trim()) return;

    const leadId = `SVS-ASC-${Date.now()}`;
    const newLeadRecord: AdminLead = {
      id: leadId,
      name: newLeadName.trim(),
      phone: newLeadPhone.trim(),
      category: 'Associate Direct Client',
      service: newLeadVenture,
      status: 'New',
      source: `Associate ${activeName} (${activeCode})`,
      notes: `Registered by Associate ${activeCode} (${activeName})`,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      assignedTo: activeCode,
      formData: {
        'Associate Code': activeCode,
        'Associate Name': activeName,
        'Associate Mobile': currentAssociate?.phone || '',
        'Client Full Name': newLeadName.trim(),
        'Client Phone': newLeadPhone.trim(),
        'Target Venture': newLeadVenture
      }
    };

    // Save directly to Firestore Cloud Database
    await dbService.setDocument(FirestoreCollections.LEADS, leadId, newLeadRecord);

    setNewLeadName('');
    setNewLeadPhone('');
    setDirectViewMode('active');
    if (onShowToast) onShowToast(`Client ${newLeadName.trim()} registered in your pipeline!`);
  };

  const handlePreFillSample = () => {
    setNewLeadName('Srikanth Reddy');
    setNewLeadPhone('+91 98480 12345');
    setNewLeadVenture('Royal City (Shadnagar)');
    if (onShowToast) onShowToast('Sample client details pre-filled. Click "Add to My List" to register!');
  };

  const handleAcceptForwardedLead = async (forwarded: Lead) => {
    await dbService.updateDocument(FirestoreCollections.LEADS, forwarded.id, {
      notes: `Accepted by Associate ${activeCode} (${activeName}) on ${new Date().toISOString()}`,
      status: 'Site Visit Scheduled',
      formData: {
        'Associate Code': activeCode,
        'Associate Name': activeName,
      }
    });
    setDirectViewMode('active');
    if (onShowToast) onShowToast(`Accepted enquiry for ${forwarded.name}. Moved to your active pipeline!`);
  };

  const handleMarkAsCompleted = async (lead: Lead) => {
    const completedDateStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString();
    await dbService.updateDocument(FirestoreCollections.LEADS, lead.id, {
      status: 'Completed',
      notes: `Completed / Plot Booked with Associate ${activeCode} on ${completedDateStr}`,
      formData: {
        'Completed Date': completedDateStr
      }
    });
    if (onShowToast) onShowToast(`Marked ${lead.name}'s deal as Completed / Registered in Firestore!`);
  };

  const handleReopenLead = async (lead: Lead) => {
    await dbService.updateDocument(FirestoreCollections.LEADS, lead.id, {
      status: 'In Progress'
    });
    setDirectViewMode('active');
    if (onShowToast) onShowToast(`Reopened ${lead.name} to active pipeline.`);
  };

  const isBrandNewAssociate = leads.length === 0 && completedLeads.length === 0 && adminForwardedLeads.length === 0;

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-300">
      
      {/* Associate Welcome Banner with Real Dynamic Details */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-7 shadow-md relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-800 bg-amber-50 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-amber-200">
                <span>Partner ID: {activeCode}</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleCopyCode}
                  className="hover:text-amber-900 cursor-pointer ml-1"
                  title="Copy Partner ID"
                >
                  {copiedCode ? <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                </button>
              </span>

              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-emerald-200">
                <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                <span>{currentAssociate?.status || 'Active'} Partner</span>

                  <MapPin className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />

            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">

import { ConciergeBookingForm, SiteInspectionBookingForm } from './forms';

interface BookingModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  bookingType: 'hotel' | 'resort' | 'event' | 'cab' | 'site-inspection';
}

export const BookingModal: React.FC<BookingModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  bookingType,
}) => {
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const isSiteInspection = bookingType === 'site-inspection';

  const modalTitles = {
    'site-inspection': 'Book a Free Site Visit',
    'hotel': 'Hotel Room Reservation',
    'resort': 'Resort & Stay Booking',
    'event': 'Book Free Event Pass',
    'cab': 'Cab & Pickup Booking',
  };

  const modalSubtitles = {
    'site-inspection': 'Complimentary AC Cab Included',
    'hotel': 'Member & Guest Stays',
    'resort': 'Member & Guest Stays',
    'event': 'VIP Passes & Summit Invitations',
    'cab': 'Airport & Travel Concierge',
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 w-full max-w-lg rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden text-slate-900 flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]">

                <MapPin className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600" />
              ) : (
                <Hotel className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-700" />
              )}
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">

              </p>

          <button

            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200 cursor-pointer transition-colors"

      unsubHosp();

}

export const FlagTicker: React.FC<FlagTickerProps> = ({ selectedCountry, onSelectCountry }) => {
  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-50 border-y border-slate-200 py-1.5 overflow-hidden relative">
      <div className="relative w-full overflow-hidden flex whitespace-nowrap py-1">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-8 animate-marquee shrink-0">
          {[...NRI_COUNTRIES, ...NRI_COUNTRIES, ...NRI_COUNTRIES].map((country, idx) => (
            <div
              key={idx}
              onClick={() => onSelectCountry(country.name)}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2.5 cursor-pointer opacity-85 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
            >
              <img src={country.flagUrl} alt={country.name} className="w-5 h-3.5 object-cover rounded-sm border border-slate-200 shadow-xs" />
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:text-emerald-700">
                SVS {country.name} Desk
              </span>
              <span className="text-slate-300">•</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Lock, ShieldCheck, UserCheck, Briefcase, Server, Sparkles, Mail, Key } from 'lucide-react';
import { MemberLoginForm, AssociateLoginForm, AdminLoginForm } from './forms';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';

interface LoginModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  initialRole?: 'member' | 'associate' | 'admin';
  onLoginSuccess?: (role: 'member' | 'associate' | 'admin', username: string, memberId?: string) => void;
  isLoggedIn?: boolean;
  userRole?: string;
  loggedInUser?: string | null;
  onNavigateToDashboard?: (role: string) => void;
  onOpenEnrollment?: () => void;
}

export const LoginModal: React.FC<LoginModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  initialRole = 'member',
  onLoginSuccess,
  isLoggedIn = false,
  userRole = 'guest',
  loggedInUser = null,
  onNavigateToDashboard,
  onOpenEnrollment,
}) => {
  const [role, setRole] = useState<'member' | 'associate' | 'admin'>(initialRole);
  const { loginDemo } = useAuth();

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSuccess = (username: string, memberId?: string) => {
    loginDemo(role, username);
    if (onLoginSuccess) {
      onLoginSuccess(role, username, memberId);
    }
  };

  const isSessionActive = isLoggedIn && userRole !== 'guest';

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden text-slate-900">
        
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-700" />
            <span>Sign In</span>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Role Selection Tabs (Only interactive if no session is active) */}
        {!isSessionActive && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 bg-slate-100 border-b border-slate-200 text-xs font-semibold p-1 gap-1">
            <button
              onClick={() => setRole('member')}
              className={`py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
                role === 'member'
                  ? 'bg-emerald-700 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              <UserCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Member</span>
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setRole('associate')}
              className={`py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
                role === 'associate'
                  ? 'bg-amber-600 text-white shadow-xs font-bold'
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              <Briefcase className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Associate</span>
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setRole('admin')}
              className={`py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
                role === 'admin'
                  ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              <Server className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Admin</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Modular Form or Active Single Session View */}
        <div className="p-6">
          {isSessionActive ? (
            <div className="py-6 px-4 text-center space-y-3 bg-emerald-50/70 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 border border-emerald-300 text-emerald-700 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto shadow-xs">
                <UserCheck className="w-6 h-6" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <h4 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                  Welcome back, {loggedInUser || 'Member'}!
                </h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-600">
                  You are already signed in to your account.
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="pt-3">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (onNavigateToDashboard) {
                      onNavigateToDashboard(userRole);
                    }
                    onClose();
                  }}
                  className="w-full py-2.5 px-4 bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-800 text-white font-bold text-xs rounded-xl shadow-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                >
                  <span>Go to My Dashboard</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {role === 'member' && (
                <MemberLoginForm onSuccess={handleSuccess} onCancel={onClose} />
              )}
              {role === 'associate' && (
                <AssociateLoginForm 
                  onSuccess={handleSuccess} 
                  onCancel={onClose} 
                  onOpenEnrollment={() => {
                    onClose();
                    if (onOpenEnrollment) onOpenEnrollment();
                  }}
                />
              )}
              {role === 'admin' && (
                <AdminLoginForm onSuccess={handleSuccess} onCancel={onClose} />
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

  loggedInUser,
  onOpenBookingModal,
  onShowToast,
  onNavigatePublic,
}) => {
  const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState<'overview' | 'booking' | 'history' | 'inspections' | 'documents' | 'app'>('overview');
  
  // Real Member Metadata directly from Firestore via useUserMetadata
  const { 
    member, 
    displayName, 
    memberId, 
    email, 
    phone, 
    plotInfo, 
    tier, 
    kycStatus, 
    isVerified, 
    isLoading: userMetaLoading, 
    refetch: refetchUserMeta 
  } = useUserMetadata(loggedInUser);

  const [appAd, setAppAd] = useState<MemberAppAd | null>(null);
  const [myRequests, setMyRequests] = useState<AdminLead[]>([]);
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState<string>('July 2026');

  // Member Action Form State
  const [serviceType, setServiceType] = useState('Resort Staycation');
  const [preferredDate, setPreferredDate] = useState('');
  const [guestCount, setGuestCount] = useState(2);
  const [specialNotes, setSpecialNotes] = useState('');
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [formSuccess, setFormSuccess] = useState(false);

  // Sync member requests & app promo from Firestore
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    const loadExtraData = async () => {
      try {
        if (memberId) {
          const reqs = await memberApi.getMemberRequests(memberId);
          if (isMounted) setMyRequests(reqs);
        }
        const ad = await memberApi.getAppAd();
        if (isMounted) setAppAd(ad);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error loading member extra data from Firestore:', err);
      }
    };
    loadExtraData();
    return () => { isMounted = false; };
  }, [memberId]);

  // Handle Form Submission (Writes to Firestore and syncs with Admin queue)
  const handleFormSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const effectiveMemberId = member?.memberId || memberId;
    const effectiveMemberName = member?.name || displayName;
    const effectivePhone = member?.phone || phone;

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      const newRequest: MemberBookingRequest = {
        memberId: effectiveMemberId,
        memberName: effectiveMemberName,
        memberPhone: effectivePhone,
        serviceType,
        preferredDate: preferredDate || 'Immediate / Flexible',
        guestCount: Number(guestCount),
        notes: specialNotes || `Allotted Plot: ${plotInfo.plotNo} @ ${plotInfo.venture}`,
        status: 'Pending',
        formData: {
          'Member ID': effectiveMemberId,
          'Member Name': effectiveMemberName,
          'Phone': effectivePhone,
          'Membership Tier': `${tier} Card`,
          'Service Requested': serviceType,
          'Preferred Date': preferredDate || 'Flexible',
          'Guests': `${guestCount} Guests`,
          'Property Allotment': `${plotInfo.plotNo} (${plotInfo.venture})`,
          'Member Notes': specialNotes || 'None'
        }
      };

      await memberApi.submitRequest(newRequest);
      setFormSuccess(true);
      if (onShowToast) onShowToast(`Your ${serviceType} request has been recorded in the cloud!`);
      
      // Reset Form & Refresh History
      setPreferredDate('');
      setSpecialNotes('');
      if (effectiveMemberId) {
        const reqs = await memberApi.getMemberRequests(effectiveMemberId);
        setMyRequests(reqs);
      }
      refetchUserMeta();
      
      setTimeout(() => setFormSuccess(false), 5000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Submission error:', err);
      if (onShowToast) onShowToast('Failed to submit request. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

      const effectiveId = member?.memberId || memberId;
      if (effectiveId) {
        const reqs = await memberApi.getMemberRequests(effectiveId);
        setMyRequests(reqs);
      }
      refetchUserMeta();
      if (onShowToast) onShowToast('Dashboard refreshed from Firestore cloud!');

      console.error('Error refreshing member data:', err);

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { MembershipCard, FirestoreCollections } from '../types';
import { MEMBERSHIP_CARDS, getMergedMembershipCards } from '../data/svsData';
import { dbService } from '../services/dbService';
import { 
  CreditCard, Sparkles, CheckCircle2, Download, Award, Shield, 
  Crown, Hotel, Wrench, ArrowRight 
} from 'lucide-react';

interface MembershipSectionProps {
  onDownloadBrochure: () => void;
  onOpenEnrollment?: () => void;
  onApplyCard?: (tier: string) => void;
}

export const MembershipSection: React.FC<MembershipSectionProps> = ({
  onDownloadBrochure,
  onOpenEnrollment,
  onApplyCard,
}) => {
  const [membershipCards, setMembershipCards] = useState<MembershipCard[]>(() => getMergedMembershipCards([]));

  // Live real-time Firestore sync for membership cards
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = dbService.subscribeToCollection<MembershipCard>(
      FirestoreCollections.CARDS,
      (cloudCards) => {
        const merged = getMergedMembershipCards(cloudCards || []);
        setMembershipCards(merged);
      }
    );

    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <section id="membership" className="py-16 sm:py-20 bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 border-t border-slate-200">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 space-y-12">
        
        {/* Section Title */}
        <div className="text-center max-w-3xl mx-auto space-y-3">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-amber-100 border border-amber-300 text-amber-900 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
            <Crown className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-700" />
            Exclusive Privilege Cards
          </div>

          <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight font-serif">
            Srivasuda Membership Division
          </h2>

          <p className="text-slate-600 text-sm sm:text-base leading-relaxed">
            Redefine luxury living and enjoy exclusive plot discounts, free luxury resort night stays, and dedicated site supervisors for your land assets in India.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Card Tiers Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
          {membershipCards.map((card) => (
            <div
              key={card.id || card.tier}
              className="rounded-2xl p-6 bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-xs hover:shadow-md hover:border-emerald-600 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-6 transition-all group"
            >
              
              {/* Card Header Visual */}
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold uppercase bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200">
                    {card.tier} Tier
                  </span>
                  <CreditCard className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400 group-hover:text-emerald-700 transition-colors" />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900">{card.tier} Card</h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{card.subtitle}</p>
                </div>

                {/* Key Metrics */}
                <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 space-y-1.5">
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span>Discount Privilege:</span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-black text-emerald-700">{card.discountPerk}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span>Free Resort Stay:</span>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{card.resortNights}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Features List */}
                <div className="space-y-2 pt-2">
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Included Perks:</div>
                  <ul className="space-y-2">
                    {card.features.map((feat, fIdx) => (
                      <li key={fIdx} className="text-xs text-slate-600 flex items-start gap-2">
                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                        <span>{feat}</span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Action Button */}
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  if (onApplyCard) {
                    onApplyCard(card.tier);
                  } else if (onOpenEnrollment) {
                    onOpenEnrollment();
                  }
                }}
                className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-800 text-white text-xs font-bold transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-xs cursor-pointer"

          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Download Brochure Bar */}
        <div className="p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-2xl bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-xs flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-6">

            <h4 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-2">

            Download PDF Brochure

  );
};

export const NriServicesSection: React.FC<NriServicesSectionProps> = ({
  onOpenConsultation,
}) => {
  // Accordion open state (default to first main service open)
  const [openMainId, setOpenMainId] = useState<string>('property-services');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [nriTiers] = useState<NriTier[]>(DEFAULT_NRI_TIERS);

  // Enquiry modal state
  const [enquireModalOpen, setEnquireModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedServices, setSelectedServices] = useState<{ main: NriMainService; sub: NriSubService }[]>([]);
  const [isMembershipMode, setIsMembershipMode] = useState(false);
  const [selectedMembershipTier, setSelectedMembershipTier] = useState<string>('Gold Executive');
  const [membershipDuration, setMembershipDuration] = useState<'1 Year' | '2 Years' | '3 Years'>('1 Year');

  // Form state
  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState('');
  const [countryOfResidence, setCountryOfResidence] = useState('');
  const [userMessage, setUserMessage] = useState('');
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submittedSuccess, setSubmittedSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [enquiryRefId, setEnquiryRefId] = useState('');

  // Toggle main accordion
  const handleToggleAccordion = (id: string) => {
    setOpenMainId((prev) => (prev === id ? '' : id));
  };

  // Toggle sub-service in selection basket
  const handleToggleService = (main: NriMainService, sub: NriSubService) => {
    setSelectedServices((prev) => {
      const exists = prev.some((item) => item.sub.id === sub.id);
      if (exists) {
        return prev.filter((item) => item.sub.id !== sub.id);
      } else {
        return [...prev, { main, sub }];
      }
    });
  };

  // Open Enquiry modal for a single sub-service
  const handleOpenSingleEnquire = (main: NriMainService, sub: NriSubService) => {
    setSelectedServices([{ main, sub }]);
    setIsMembershipMode(false);
    setSubmittedSuccess(false);
    setEnquireModalOpen(true);
  };

  // Open modal from bottom floating bar (multi-select)
  const handleOpenBasketEnquire = () => {
    if (selectedServices.length === 0) return;
    if (selectedServices.length > 3) {
      setIsMembershipMode(true);
    }
    setSubmittedSuccess(false);
    setEnquireModalOpen(true);
  };

  // Remove a specific service from selected basket
  const handleRemoveService = (subId: string) => {
    setSelectedServices((prev) => {
      const updated = prev.filter((item) => item.sub.id !== subId);
      if (updated.length === 0) {
        setEnquireModalOpen(false);
      } else if (updated.length <= 3 && isMembershipMode) {
        // user can stay or toggle
      }
      return updated;
    });
  };

  // Submit form
  const handleSubmitEnquiry = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!fullName || !phone || selectedServices.length === 0) return;

    // Strict Rule: If more than 3 services, force membership mode
    if (!isMembershipMode && selectedServices.length > 3) {
      setIsMembershipMode(true);
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    const refId = isMembershipMode 
      ? `MEM-${Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000)}`
      : `NRI-${Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000)}`;
    setEnquiryRefId(refId);

    const serviceNames = selectedServices.map((s) => s.sub.name).join(', ');
    const mainCategories = Array.from(new Set(selectedServices.map((s) => s.main.title))).join(', ');

    const leadPayload = {
      id: refId,
      name: fullName,
      phone: phone,
      email: email || 'N/A',
      country: countryOfResidence || 'Overseas',
      category: 'NRI Services',
      service: isMembershipMode 
        ? `NRI Care Membership (${selectedMembershipTier} - ${membershipDuration})` 
        : `NRI On-Demand Services (${selectedServices.length} Selected)`,
      source: isMembershipMode ? 'NRI Annual Membership Flow' : 'NRI On-Demand Services Flow',
      notes: isMembershipMode 
        ? `Tier: ${selectedMembershipTier} | Plan: ${membershipDuration} | Included Services: ${selectedServices.length} | Country: ${countryOfResidence || 'N/A'} | Msg: ${userMessage}`
        : `Categories: ${mainCategories} | Country: ${countryOfResidence || 'N/A'} | Selected Count: ${selectedServices.length} | Msg: ${userMessage}`,
      formData: {
        'Client Full Name': fullName,
        'Contact Phone': phone,
        'Email Address': email || 'Not Provided',
        'Country of Residence': countryOfResidence || 'Not Specified',
        'Enquiry Mode': isMembershipMode ? 'Annual Care Membership Retainer' : 'On-Demand Custom Services',
        'Membership Plan Tier': isMembershipMode ? selectedMembershipTier : 'N/A (Individual Services)',
        'Membership Duration': isMembershipMode ? membershipDuration : 'N/A',
        'Selected Services Breakdown': selectedServices.map(s => `• ${s.main.title}: ${s.sub.name} (TAT: ${s.sub.turnaroundTime})`).join('\n'),
        'Total Services Selected': `${selectedServices.length} Service(s)`,
        'Consultation Query / Notes': userMessage || 'Standard consultation requested',
      }
    };

    dbService.setDocument(FirestoreCollections.LEADS, refId, leadPayload)
      .catch((err) => console.error('[NriServicesSection] Failed to write lead to Firestore:', err))
      .finally(() => {
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        setSubmittedSuccess(true);
        setFullName('');
        setEmail('');
        setPhone('');
        setCountryOfResidence('');
        setUserMessage('');
      });
  };

  // Filter services based on search query
  const filteredServices = NRI_FUNCTIONAL_SERVICES.map((main) => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return main;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    const matchesMain = main.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || main.description.toLowerCase().includes(q);
    const matchedSubs = main.subServices.filter(
      (sub) => sub.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || sub.summary.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
    if (matchesMain || matchedSubs.length > 0) {
      return {
        ...main,
        subServices: matchedSubs.length > 0 ? matchedSubs : main.subServices
      };
    }
    return null;
  }).filter((item): item is NriMainService => item !== null);

  return (
    <section id="nri-division" className="py-12 sm:py-16 bg-white text-slate-900 border-t border-slate-200 relative">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 space-y-12">
        
        {/* Dedicated NRI Hero Showcase */}
        <div className="relative rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 p-6 sm:p-10 lg:p-12 border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
          <div className="relative z-10 max-w-3xl space-y-5">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-700" />
              WE ARE ALWAYS AT YOUR SERVICE • GLOBAL INDIAN INVESTOR DESK
            </div>

            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-black tracking-tight leading-tight text-slate-900 font-serif">
              Invest in Prime Land & Manage Property from <span className="text-emerald-700">Anywhere in the World</span>
            </h1>

            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-600 leading-relaxed max-w-2xl font-medium">
              End-to-end legal title verification, remote live drone site inspections, NRE/NRO rupee remittance, GPA registration, and 8 specialized on-ground concierge service categories for overseas Indians.
            </p>

            {/* Quick Metrics */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4 pt-4 border-t border-slate-200">
              <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
                <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-amber-700">3,200+</div>
                <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">NRI Investors</div>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
                <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-700">100%</div>
                <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Clear Title (TS RERA)</div>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
                <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800">18+</div>
                <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Countries Served</div>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
                <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-800">24/7</div>
                <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Concierge Desk</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Overseas Branches (USA, UK, Singapore, Malaysia, UAE, Thailand) */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-end justify-between gap-2">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight font-serif">
                Our Overseas Branches
              </h3>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 max-w-sm">
              Local branch offices and time-zone aligned support for overseas buyers.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {NRI_COUNTRIES.map((country) => (
              <div 
                key={country.code} 
                className="p-5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 space-y-3 shadow-xs hover:border-emerald-600 transition-colors"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <img 
                      src={country.flagUrl} 
                      alt={country.name} 
                      className="w-7 h-4.5 object-cover rounded border border-slate-200 shadow-xs" 
                    />
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">{country.name} Branch</h4>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500">{country.timeZone.split('(')[0].trim()}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-200">
                    {country.activeNriClients}+ Investors
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="text-xs text-slate-700 space-y-1.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 text-[11px]">
                    <span className="text-slate-500 font-medium">Branch Lead:</span>
                    <span className="text-slate-900 font-semibold text-right">{country.deskManager}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 text-[11px]">
                    <span className="text-slate-500 font-medium">City / Area:</span>
                    <span className="text-slate-700 text-right">{country.deskLocation}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 text-[11px]">
                    <span className="text-slate-500 font-medium">Phone Support:</span>
                    <span className="text-emerald-700 font-mono font-bold text-right">{country.deskPhone.split('/')[0]}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Functional Header featuring brochure slogan */}
        <div className="text-center max-w-3xl mx-auto space-y-3 pt-4 border-t border-slate-200">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-700" />
            WE ARE ALWAYS AT YOUR SERVICE
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight font-serif">
            NRI & Member Services Directory
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-600 text-xs sm:text-sm leading-relaxed">
            Select a primary service category below to open its sub-services list. Click any sub-service to submit an immediate consultation enquiry directly to our Admin & Member Support Desk.
          </p>

          {/* Quick Search Bar */}
          <div className="pt-3 max-w-md mx-auto">
            <div className="relative">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
              <input
                type="text"
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search service (e.g. Sales, Construction, Tax, Senior Citizen, Cab, Electricity)..."
                className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-slate-900 text-xs font-medium placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 shadow-xs"
              />
              {searchQuery && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                  className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700"
                >
                  <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Main Accordion List */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {filteredServices.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-8 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-center space-y-2">
              <AlertCircle className="w-8 h-8 text-amber-500 mx-auto" />
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">No Matching Services Found</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                We couldn't find any NRI sub-service matching "{searchQuery}". Try a different keyword or browse all categories.
              </p>
              <button
                onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                className="mt-2 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 text-xs font-bold text-slate-800"
              >
                Reset Search
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            filteredServices.map((mainService) => {
              const isOpen = openMainId === mainService.id || searchQuery.trim().length > 0;

              return (
                <div
                  key={mainService.id}
                  className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden transition-all shadow-xs"
                >
                  {/* Main Service Header (Clickable Accordion Trigger) */}
                  <div
                    onClick={() => handleToggleAccordion(mainService.id)}
                    className="p-5 sm:p-6 cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-start sm:items-center gap-3.5 min-w-0">
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5 sm:mt-0">
                        <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5" />
                      </div>
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                          <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200">
                            {mainService.categoryTag}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">
                            {mainService.subServices.length} Sub-Services
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1">
                          {mainService.title}
                        </h3>
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-0.5 line-clamp-1 sm:line-clamp-none">
                          {mainService.description}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="shrink-0 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 hidden sm:inline-block">
                        {isOpen ? 'Collapse' : 'View Sub-Services'}
                      </span>
                      <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-600 border border-slate-200">
                        {isOpen ? (
                          <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-700" />
                        ) : (
                          <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Sub-Services Expanded List */}
                  {isOpen && (
                    <div className="border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-4">
                      <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-800 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        Available Sub-Services under {mainService.title}:
                      </div>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                        {mainService.subServices.map((subService) => {
                          const isSelected = selectedServices.some((s) => s.sub.id === subService.id);
                          return (
                            <div
                              key={subService.id}
                              className={`p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-xl border transition-all flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3 ${
                                isSelected 
                                  ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-500 shadow-xs ring-1 ring-emerald-500' 
                                  : 'bg-white border-slate-200 hover:border-emerald-500'
                              }`}
                            >
                              <div className="space-y-2">
                                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                                    <button
                                      type="button"
                                      onClick={(e) => {
                                        e.stopPropagation();
                                        handleToggleService(mainService, subService);
                                      }}
                                      className={`mt-0.5 w-4 h-4 rounded flex items-center justify-center border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                                        isSelected 
                                          ? 'bg-emerald-600 border-emerald-600 text-white font-black text-xs' 
                                          : 'border-slate-300 bg-white hover:border-emerald-600 text-transparent'
                                      }`}
                                    >
                                      ✓
                                    </button>
                                    <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                                      {subService.name}
                                    </h4>
                                  </div>
                                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 shrink-0">
                                    {subService.turnaroundTime}
                                  </span>
                                </div>

                                <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 leading-relaxed pl-6">
                                  {subService.summary}
                                </p>

                                {/* Deliverables checklist */}
                                <div className="pt-1 pl-6 space-y-1">
                                  {subService.deliverables.slice(0, 3).map((item, idx) => (
                                    <div key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                                      <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                                      <span>{item}</span>
                                    </div>
                                  ))}
                                </div>
                              </div>

                              <div className="pt-2 pl-6 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => handleToggleService(mainService, subService)}
                                  className={`text-[11px] font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                                    isSelected 
                                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white font-bold' 
                                      : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200 border border-slate-200'
                                  }`}
                                >
                                  {isSelected ? '✓ Added to Basket' : '+ Add to Request'}
                                </button>
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => handleOpenSingleEnquire(mainService, subService)}
                                  className="text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-700 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                                >
                                  Request Only This
                                  <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                </button>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Bottom Functional Help Box */}
        <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
              <HelpCircle className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                Need a Custom NRI Service Not Listed Above?
              </h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-600">
                Our NRI Support Desk handles custom property power of attorney, tax certificates, and litigation assistance.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onOpenConsultation}
            className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-800 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 transition-colors shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
          >
            <PhoneCall className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Contact NRI Desk Executive
          </button>
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* Floating Bottom Basket Bar */}
      {selectedServices.length > 0 && !enquireModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 animate-in slide-in-from-bottom duration-300 w-auto max-w-[90vw]">
          <div className="bg-white border border-emerald-500 shadow-xl px-5 py-3 rounded-full flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-emerald-700 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
                {selectedServices.length}
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 block whitespace-nowrap">
                  {selectedServices.length} {selectedServices.length === 1 ? 'Service Selected' : 'Services in Basket'}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 hidden sm:inline block whitespace-nowrap">
                  Ready for single combined request
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={handleOpenBasketEnquire}
              className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-800 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-xs transition-colors whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer"
            >
              Proceed to Request
              <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MODAL: Sub-Service Enquiry Form (Light Mode) */}
      {enquireModalOpen && selectedServices.length > 0 && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xs p-4 animate-in fade-in">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-2xl max-w-xl w-full p-6 space-y-5 max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto">
            
            {/* Modal Header */}
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between border-b border-slate-200 pb-4">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold uppercase px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded border ${
                    isMembershipMode
                      ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 border-amber-300'
                      : 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200'
                  }`}>
                    {isMembershipMode ? 'Annual Care Membership' : `Pay-As-You-Go (${selectedServices.length} Selected)`}
                  </span>
                  {selectedServices.length > 3 && !isMembershipMode && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-rose-700 bg-rose-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-rose-200">
                      Exceeds 3 Services Limit
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1.5">
                  {isMembershipMode 
                    ? 'Annual NRI Property Care Membership Enrollment' 
                    : (selectedServices.length === 1 ? `Request: ${selectedServices[0].sub.name}` : 'Multi-Service On-Demand Request')}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  {isMembershipMode 
                    ? 'Comprehensive year-round property protection, recurring visits & dedicated manager.' 
                    : 'Pay per service on-demand (Maximum 3 services per single request).'}
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setEnquireModalOpen(false)}
                className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {submittedSuccess ? (
              <div className="py-8 text-center space-y-4">
                <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 mx-auto flex items-center justify-center border border-emerald-200">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-8 h-8" />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <h4 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
                    {isMembershipMode ? 'Membership Application Received!' : 'Service Request Submitted Successfully!'}
                  </h4>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed">
                    {isMembershipMode 
                      ? <>Your application for the <strong className="text-amber-800">{selectedMembershipTier} ({membershipDuration})</strong> plan covering <strong className="text-emerald-800">{selectedServices.length} selected services</strong> has been assigned to a Senior NRI Client Partner.</>

} from 'lucide-react';

  onSelectProject: (project: Project) => void;
  onDownloadBrochure: () => void;
}

}) => {

      (cloudProjects) => {

                    </button>
                  </div>

                </div>

              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

} from 'lucide-react';

import { Project, FirestoreCollections } from '../types';

interface PropertySectionProps {
  onOpenBookingModal?: (type: 'hotel' | 'resort' | 'event' | 'cab' | 'site-inspection') => void;
  onDownloadBrochure?: () => void;
  onOpenLogin?: (role?: 'member' | 'associate' | 'admin') => void;
  isLoggedIn?: boolean;
}

  onOpenBookingModal,
  onDownloadBrochure,
  onOpenLogin,
  isLoggedIn = false
}) => {

  const [projectsList, setProjectsList] = useState<Project[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Real-time live Firestore subscription
    const unsubscribeCloud = dbService.subscribeToCollection<Project>(
      FirestoreCollections.VENTURES,
      (cloudProjects) => {
        setProjectsList(cloudProjects || []);
      }
    );

    return () => {
      unsubscribeCloud();
    };
  }, []);

  const [selectedType, setSelectedType] = useState<'all' | 'plot' | 'villa' | 'apartment'>('all');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');

      plots: projectsList.filter(p => p.propertyType === 'plot').length,

export const AdminEventsTab: React.FC<AdminEventsTabProps> = ({ onShowToast }) => {
  const [events, setEvents] = useState<SvsEvent[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isSeeding, setIsSeeding] = useState(false);

  // Filters
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState('all');

  // Modal State
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingEvent, setEditingEvent] = useState<SvsEvent | null>(null);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  // Form State
  const [form, setForm] = useState<Partial<SvsEvent>>({
    id: '',
    title: '',
    date: '',
    time: '',
    location: '',
    type: 'Annual Gala',
    badge: 'Member Exclusive',
    image: '',
    description: '',
    perks: [],
    capacity: '200 Guests',
  });
  const [perksInput, setPerksInput] = useState('');

  // Delete Confirmation Modal State
  const [deleteConfirmEvent, setDeleteConfirmEvent] = useState<SvsEvent | null>(null);

  // Real-time subscription to Firestore EVENTS collection
  useEffect(() => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    const unsubscribe = dbService.subscribeToCollection<SvsEvent>(
      FirestoreCollections.EVENTS,
      (cloudEvents) => {
        setEvents(cloudEvents || []);
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    );

    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, []);

  // Filter logic
  const filteredEvents = events.filter((ev) => {
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    const matchesSearch =
      !q ||
      ev.title?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      ev.location?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      ev.description?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      ev.badge?.toLowerCase().includes(q);

    const matchesType = typeFilter === 'all' || ev.type === typeFilter;

    return matchesSearch && matchesType;
  });

  const handleOpenAdd = () => {
    setEditingEvent(null);
    const nextWeekDate = new Date(Date.now() + 14 * 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0];
    setForm({

      title: '',
      date: nextWeekDate,
      time: '06:00 PM IST',
      location: 'SVS Vasudha Eco-Resorts Grand Lawn, Hyderabad',

      image: '',

    setEditingEvent(evt);
    setForm({ ...evt });
    setPerksInput((evt.perks || []).join('\n'));
    setIsModalOpen(true);

    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.title || !form.date || !form.location) {

      return;
    }

    setIsSaving(true);
    const cleanedPerks = perksInput
      .split('\n')

      .filter(Boolean);

      id: form.id || `evt-${Date.now()}`,

      date: form.date.trim(),
      time: form.time?.trim() || '10:00 AM IST',
      location: form.location.trim(),
      type: form.type?.trim() || 'Member Summit',
      badge: form.badge?.trim() || 'SVS Event',
      image: form.image || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1511795409834-ef04bbd61622?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80',
      description: form.description?.trim() || 'Join us for this signature SVS community gathering.',
      perks: cleanedPerks.length > 0 ? cleanedPerks : ['Complimentary Member Entry', 'Refreshments Included'],
      capacity: form.capacity?.trim() || 'Open for Members',
      createdAt: form.createdAt || Date.now(),
    };

    try {
      const res = await dbService.setDocument(FirestoreCollections.EVENTS, eventToSave.id, eventToSave);
      if (res.success) {
        onShowToast(editingEvent ? `Updated event "${eventToSave.title}"` : `Published new event "${eventToSave.title}"`);
        setIsModalOpen(false);
      } else {
        onShowToast('Failed to save event: ' + (res.error || 'Unknown error'));
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Error saving event to Firestore:', err);
      onShowToast('Error saving event: ' + (err?.message || ''));
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleteConfirmEvent) return;
    const evt = deleteConfirmEvent;
    try {
      await dbService.deleteDocument(FirestoreCollections.EVENTS, evt.id);
      onShowToast(`Deleted event "${evt.title}"`);
      setDeleteConfirmEvent(null);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Error deleting event:', err);
      onShowToast('Error deleting event: ' + (err?.message || ''));
    }
  };

        const id = `evt-svs-${count + 1}`;
        await dbService.setDocument(FirestoreCollections.EVENTS, id, { ...sample, id });

          <button

                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, capacity: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="e.g. 250 Guests / Limited Seats"
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 text-white placeholder:text-slate-600 focus:outline-none"
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Image Upload */}
                <div className="sm:col-span-2 pt-2">
                  <DeviceImageUpload
                    label="Event Banner / Promotional Poster (Upload from Device)"
                    value={form.image}
                    onChange={(newImg) => setForm({ ...form, image: newImg })}
                    required={false}
                    hint="Upload event banner from your device or paste an image link."
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Description */}
                <div className="sm:col-span-2 space-y-1">
                  <label className="text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase text-[10px]">
                    Event Description
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    rows={3}
                    value={form.description}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="Describe the occasion, special guest dignitaries, agenda, and expectations..."
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 text-white placeholder:text-slate-600 focus:outline-none"
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Perks Checklist */}
                <div className="sm:col-span-2 space-y-1">
                  <label className="text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase text-[10px]">
                    Event Inclusions & Member Perks (One per line)
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    rows={3}
                    value={perksInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setPerksInput(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Complimentary Banquet Dining for Family&#10;Priority Venture Allocation Voucher&#10;Live Musical Orchestration"
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 text-white placeholder:text-slate-600 focus:outline-none font-mono text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Modal Actions */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 pt-3 border-t border-slate-800">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 font-bold cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isSaving}
                  className="px-6 py-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-black shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/30 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 transition-all"
                >
                  {isSaving ? 'Saving to Database...' : editingEvent ? 'Update Event' : 'Publish Event'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {/* CONFIRM DELETE MODAL */}
      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {deleteConfirmEvent && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-sm p-4 animate-in fade-in">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-6 max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="p-3 bg-rose-500/10 rounded-2xl text-rose-400 shrink-0">
                <Trash2 className="w-6 h-6" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h4 className="text-base font-black text-white">Delete Event?</h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                  Are you sure you want to delete <strong className="text-white">{deleteConfirmEvent.title}</strong>?
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-950 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
              This event will be deleted from Firestore and immediately removed from the member events calendar.
            </p>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => setDeleteConfirmEvent(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleDelete}
                className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white font-black text-xs shadow-lg shadow-rose-600/30 cursor-pointer"
              >
                Yes, Delete Permanently
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
