export const AdminVenturesTab: React.FC<AdminVenturesTabProps> = ({ onShowToast }) => {
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isSeeding, setIsSeeding] = useState(false);

  // Filters
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [stateFilter, setStateFilter] = useState<'all' | 'telangana' | 'andhra_pradesh'>('all');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<'all' | 'ongoing' | 'completed' | 'upcoming'>('all');
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState<'all' | 'plot' | 'villa' | 'apartment'>('all');

  // Modal State
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingProject, setEditingProject] = useState<Project | null>(null);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  // Form State
  const [form, setForm] = useState<Partial<Project>>({
    id: '',
    title: '',
    zone: '',
    location: '',
    state: 'telangana',
    propertyType: 'plot',
    status: 'ongoing',
    image: '',
    shortDesc: '',
    highlights: [],
    startingPrice: '',
    plotsAvailable: 25,
    totalArea: '',
    configuration: '',
    approvalType: 'DTCP & TS-RERA',
    reraNumber: '',
    possession: 'Immediate Registration',
    isFeatured: false,
  });
  const [highlightsInput, setHighlightsInput] = useState('');
  const [planImage, setPlanImage] = useState('');

  // Delete Confirmation Modal State
  const [deleteConfirmProject, setDeleteConfirmProject] = useState<Project | null>(null);

  // Real-time subscription to Firestore VENTURES collection
  useEffect(() => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    const unsubscribe = dbService.subscribeToCollection<Project>(
      FirestoreCollections.VENTURES,
      (cloudProjects) => {
        setProjects(cloudProjects || []);
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    );

    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, []);

  // Filter logic
  const filteredProjects = projects.filter((p) => {
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    const matchesSearch =
      !q ||
      p.title?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      p.zone?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      p.location?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      p.reraNumber?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      p.approvalType?.toLowerCase().includes(q);

    const matchesState = stateFilter === 'all' || p.state === stateFilter;
    const matchesStatus = statusFilter === 'all' || p.status === statusFilter;
    const matchesType = typeFilter === 'all' || p.propertyType === typeFilter;

    return matchesSearch && matchesState && matchesStatus && matchesType;
  });

  const handleOpenAdd = () => {
    setEditingProject(null);
    setForm({
      id: `proj-${Date.now()}`,
      title: '',
      zone: '',
      location: '',
      state: 'telangana',
      propertyType: 'plot',
      status: 'ongoing',
      image: '',
      shortDesc: '',
      highlights: [],
      startingPrice: '₹14,000 / sq.yd',
      plotsAvailable: 25,
      totalArea: '30 Acres',
      configuration: '165 - 350 Sq. Yds',
      approvalType: 'DTCP & TS-RERA',
      reraNumber: 'P0240000' + Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000),
      possession: 'Immediate Registration',
      isFeatured: false,
    });
    setHighlightsInput('DTCP Approved Layout\n60ft & 33ft Wide Blacktop Roads\nUnderground Drainage & Electricity Cabling\nSpot Registration with Clear Title');
    setPlanImage('');
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (proj: Project) => {
    setEditingProject(proj);
    setForm({ ...proj });
    setHighlightsInput((proj.highlights || []).join('\n'));
    setPlanImage(proj.gallery?.[0] || '');
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.title || !form.location) {
      onShowToast('Please fill in required fields (Title, Location).');
      return;
    }

    setIsSaving(true);
    const cleanedHighlights = highlightsInput
      .split('\n')
      .map((h) => h.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);

    const projectToSave: Project = {
      id: form.id || `proj-${Date.now()}`,
      title: form.title.trim(),
      zone: form.zone?.trim() || 'Hyderabad Growth Corridor',
      location: form.location.trim(),
      state: form.state || 'telangana',
      propertyType: form.propertyType || 'plot',
      status: form.status || 'ongoing',
      image: form.image || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1500382017468-9049fed747ef?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80',
      gallery: planImage ? [planImage] : form.gallery || [],
      shortDesc: form.shortDesc?.trim() || 'Approved layout with clear titles and complete infrastructural developments.',
      highlights: cleanedHighlights.length > 0 ? cleanedHighlights : ['DTCP Approved Layout', 'Clear Title Guarantee'],
      startingPrice: form.startingPrice?.trim() || 'Price on Request',
      plotsAvailable: Number(form.plotsAvailable) || 0,
      totalArea: form.totalArea?.trim() || 'Plotted Layout',
      configuration: form.configuration?.trim() || 'Standard Plots',
      approvalType: form.approvalType?.trim() || 'DTCP Approved',
      reraNumber: form.reraNumber?.trim() || 'Clear Title Verified',
      possession: form.possession?.trim() || 'Ready to Register',
      isFeatured: !!form.isFeatured,
    };

    try {
      const res = await dbService.setDocument(FirestoreCollections.VENTURES, projectToSave.id, projectToSave);
      if (res.success) {
        onShowToast(editingProject ? `Updated venture "${projectToSave.title}"` : `Published new venture "${projectToSave.title}"`);
        setIsModalOpen(false);
      } else {
        onShowToast('Failed to save venture: ' + (res.error || 'Unknown error'));
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Error saving venture to Firestore:', err);
      onShowToast('Error saving venture to database: ' + (err?.message || ''));
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleteConfirmProject) return;
    const p = deleteConfirmProject;
    try {
      await dbService.deleteDocument(FirestoreCollections.VENTURES, p.id);
      onShowToast(`Deleted venture "${p.title}" from live database`);
      setDeleteConfirmProject(null);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Error deleting venture:', err);
      onShowToast('Error deleting venture: ' + (err?.message || ''));
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFeatured = async (p: Project, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const updated = !p.isFeatured;
    try {
      await dbService.updateDocument(FirestoreCollections.VENTURES, p.id, { isFeatured: updated });
      onShowToast(`Venture "${p.title}" ${updated ? 'marked as Featured' : 'unmarked from Featured'}`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to toggle featured:', err);
    }
  };

  const handleSeedOfficialVentures = async () => {
    setIsSeeding(true);
    try {
      let count = 0;
      for (const sample of SAMPLE_OFFICIAL_VENTURES) {
        const id = `proj-svs-${count + 1}`;
        await dbService.setDocument(FirestoreCollections.VENTURES, id, { ...sample, id });
        count++;
      }
      onShowToast(`Successfully seeded ${count} official SVS ventures into Firestore!`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Error seeding ventures:', err);
      onShowToast('Error seeding ventures: ' + (err?.message || ''));
    } finally {
      setIsSeeding(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-slate-900 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-800 shadow-sm">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-black text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <Building2 className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400" />
            <span>Ventures & Projects Management (Firestore CMS)</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
            Create, update, or remove real estate ventures and upload site imagery. All updates sync instantly to the public Property Section.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0">
          {projects.length === 0 && (
            <button
              onClick={handleSeedOfficialVentures}
              disabled={isSeeding}
              className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-amber-500/10 hover:bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 font-bold text-xs rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              title="Populate initial verified SVS ventures"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isSeeding ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
              <span>{isSeeding ? 'Seeding...' : 'Seed Sample Ventures'}</span>
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={handleOpenAdd}
            className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-black text-xs rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/30 flex items-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>+ Add New Venture</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter Bar */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        <div className="relative sm:col-span-1">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search by title, corridor, or RERA..."
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-xs text-white placeholder:text-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500"
          />
        </div>

        <select
          value={stateFilter}
          onChange={(e) => setStateFilter(e.target.value as any)}
          className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500"
        >
          <option value="all">All States (Telangana & AP)</option>
          <option value="telangana">Telangana State Only</option>
          <option value="andhra_pradesh">Andhra Pradesh State Only</option>
        </select>

        <select
          value={statusFilter}
          onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value as any)}
          className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500"
        >
          <option value="all">All Lifecycle Statuses</option>
          <option value="ongoing">Active / Open for Sale</option>
          <option value="completed">Completed & Delivered</option>
          <option value="upcoming">Upcoming Pre-Launch</option>
        </select>

        <select
          value={typeFilter}
          onChange={(e) => setTypeFilter(e.target.value as any)}
          className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500"
        >
          <option value="all">All Asset Types</option>
          <option value="plot">Open Land Plots</option>
          <option value="villa">Gated Villas</option>
          <option value="apartment">Apartments</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      {/* Ventures Cards Grid */}
      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="p-12 text-center bg-slate-900/60 rounded-3xl border border-slate-800 text-slate-400 space-y-3">
          <RefreshCw className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto text-amber-400 animate-spin" />
          <p className="text-xs font-bold">Synchronizing Ventures from Firestore...</p>
        </div>
      ) : filteredProjects.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-12 text-center bg-slate-900/60 rounded-3xl border border-slate-800 text-slate-400 space-y-4">
          <div className="w-14 h-14 mx-auto rounded-2xl bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-500">
            <Building2 className="w-7 h-7" />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-white">No Ventures Found</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-md mx-auto">
              {projects.length === 0
                ? 'Your Firestore database has no ventures yet. Add your first venture or click Seed Sample Ventures below.'
                : 'No ventures match your filter criteria. Try adjusting your search query.'}
            </p>
          </div>
          {projects.length === 0 && (
            <div className="flex justify-center gap-3 pt-2">
              <button
                onClick={handleOpenAdd}
                className="px-5 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold text-xs rounded-xl shadow transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                + Add First Venture
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleSeedOfficialVentures}
                disabled={isSeeding}
                className="px-5 py-2 bg-amber-500/10 hover:bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 font-bold text-xs rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                Seed Verified SVS Ventures
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
          {filteredProjects.map((project) => (
            <div
              key={project.id}
              className="bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-slate-700 transition-all shadow-md group"
            >
              {/* Cover Image & Badges */}
              <div className="relative h-48 w-full bg-slate-950 overflow-hidden">
                <img
                  src={project.image}
                  alt={project.title}
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-500"
                  referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                />
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-slate-950/95 via-slate-950/30 to-transparent" />

                {/* Top Badges */}
                <div className="absolute top-2.5 left-2.5 right-2.5 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span
                    className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider ${
                      project.status === 'ongoing'
                        ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                        : project.status === 'completed'
                        ? 'bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 shadow-sm'
                        : 'bg-cyan-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {project.status === 'ongoing' ? 'Active / Selling' : project.status === 'completed' ? 'Completed' : 'Pre-Launch'}
                  </span>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <button
                      onClick={(e) => handleToggleFeatured(project, e)}
                      className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold border transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                        project.isFeatured
                          ? 'bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 border-amber-400'
                          : 'bg-slate-900/80 text-slate-400 border-slate-700 hover:text-amber-300'
                      }`}
                      title={project.isFeatured ? 'Featured on Homepage (Click to disable)' : 'Mark as Featured'}
                    >
                      <Star className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${project.isFeatured ? 'fill-current' : ''}`} />
                    </button>
                    <span className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-700 text-amber-300 text-[10px] font-bold">
                      {project.state === 'telangana' ? 'Telangana' : 'Andhra Pradesh'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Bottom Overlay Info */}
                <div className="absolute bottom-2.5 left-2.5 right-2.5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                  <span className="font-black text-white capitalize flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    {project.propertyType === 'plot' && <Trees className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />}
                    {project.propertyType === 'villa' && <Home className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />}
                    {project.propertyType === 'apartment' && <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />}
                    <span>{project.propertyType}</span>
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold bg-slate-950/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-amber-500/30">
                    {project.startingPrice}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Card Body */}

                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                      {project.zone}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                      {project.plotsAvailable} Plots Left
                    </span>

                  >
                    <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
                    <span>Edit Venture</span>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => setDeleteConfirmProject(project)}

                  <Building2 className="w-5 h-5" />

=== FILE: C:\Users\moham\Downloads\svs-final\src\components\common\DeviceImageUpload.tsx ===
import React, { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Upload, X, Link as LinkIcon, AlertCircle, Check, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface DeviceImageUploadProps {
  label?: string;
  value?: string;
  onChange: (base64OrUrl: string) => void;
  required?: boolean;
  hint?: string;
  id?: string;
}

export const DeviceImageUpload: React.FC<DeviceImageUploadProps> = ({
  label = 'Upload Image from Device',
  value,
  onChange,
  required = false,
  hint = 'Supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP (Auto-optimized for web)',
  id = 'device-img-input',
}) => {
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [showUrlInput, setShowUrlInput] = useState(false);
  const [customUrl, setCustomUrl] = useState('');
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Compress & resize image to safe dimensions (<1280px, ~100-200KB)
  const compressImage = (file: File): Promise<string> => {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
      reader.onload = (event) => {
        const img = new Image();
        img.src = event.target?.result as string;
        img.onload = () => {
          const maxDim = 1280;
          let width = img.width;
          let height = img.height;

          if (width > maxDim || height > maxDim) {
            if (width > height) {
              height = Math.round((height * maxDim) / width);
              width = maxDim;
            } else {
              width = Math.round((width * maxDim) / height);
              height = maxDim;
            }
          }

          const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          canvas.width = width;
          canvas.height = height;
          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
          if (!ctx) {
            resolve(event.target?.result as string);
            return;
          }

          ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
          // Compress to JPEG with 0.82 quality
          const compressedDataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.82);
          resolve(compressedDataUrl);
        };
        img.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to parse image.'));
      };
      reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to read file.'));
    });
  };

  const handleFileChange = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    setErrorMessage(null);
    setIsProcessing(true);

    try {
      const optimizedDataUrl = await compressImage(file);
      onChange(optimizedDataUrl);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Image compression error:', err);
      setErrorMessage('Could not process this image. Please try another.');
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRemove = () => {
    onChange('');
    setCustomUrl('');
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };

  const handleApplyUrl = () => {
    if (customUrl.trim()) {
      onChange(customUrl.trim());
      setShowUrlInput(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2 w-full">
      {label && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <label className="text-slate-300 font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1">
            <span>{label}</span>
            {required && <span className="text-rose-400">*</span>}
          </label>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {value && (
              <span className="text-[11px] text-emerald-400 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                <Check className="w-3 h-3" /> Image Ready
              </span>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowUrlInput(!showUrlInput)}
              className="text-[11px] text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-300 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
            >
              <LinkIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
              {showUrlInput ? 'Hide URL' : 'Use Web URL'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {showUrlInput && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 animate-in fade-in">
          <input
            type="url"
            value={customUrl}
            onChange={(e) => setCustomUrl(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="https://example.com/venture-image.jpg"
            className="flex-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-xs text-white placeholder:text-slate-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500"
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleApplyUrl}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 text-xs font-black cursor-pointer transition-colors"
          >
            Apply
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {errorMessage && (
        <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{errorMessage}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {value ? (
        <div className="relative rounded-2xl border border-slate-700/80 bg-slate-900/90 p-2.5 flex items-center gap-3 shadow-inner">
          <img
            src={value}
            alt="Uploaded Preview"
            className="w-20 h-16 object-cover rounded-xl border border-slate-700 shrink-0 bg-slate-950"
            referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
          />
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-white truncate">Image Attached & Verified</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 truncate">Stored dynamically in Firestore</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
              disabled={isProcessing}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-200 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              {isProcessing ? 'Processing...' : 'Change'}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleRemove}
              className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-400 hover:bg-rose-500/10 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Remove image"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div
          onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
          className="border-2 border-dashed border-slate-700 hover:border-amber-400/70 rounded-2xl p-5 text-center bg-slate-950/60 hover:bg-slate-900/60 transition-all cursor-pointer group"
        >
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 flex items-center justify-center group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
              {isProcessing ? (
                <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <Upload className="w-5 h-5" />
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-white">
              {isProcessing ? 'Optimizing image...' : 'Click to browse & upload from this device'}
            </p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">{hint}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <input
        ref={fileInputRef}
        id={id}
        type="file"
        accept="image/*"
        onChange={handleFileChange}
        className="hidden"
      />
    </div>
  );
};

import { Users, Lock, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, ArrowRight, Briefcase, Eye, EyeOff, Clock, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import { authService } from '../../../services/authService';

interface AssociateLoginFormProps {
  onSuccess: (username: string, associateCode?: string) => void;
  onCancel?: () => void;
  onOpenEnrollment?: () => void;
}

export const AssociateLoginForm: React.FC<AssociateLoginFormProps> = ({ onSuccess, onCancel, onOpenEnrollment }) => {
  const [associateCode, setAssociateCode] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState('');
  const [pendingNotice, setPendingNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSuccess, setIsSuccess] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMsg('');
    setPendingNotice(null);

    if (!associateCode.trim() || !password.trim()) {
      setErrorMsg('Please enter your Associate Code or Mobile Number and Password.');
      return;
    }

    setIsLoading(true);

    try {
      const result = await authService.loginAssociate(associateCode, password);
      setIsLoading(false);

      if (!result.success) {
        if (result.isPending) {
          setPendingNotice(result.error || 'Your application is awaiting Admin Acceptance.');
        } else {
          setErrorMsg(result.error || 'Authentication failed. Please verify credentials.');
        }
        return;
      }

      setIsSuccess(true);
      const asc = result.associate;
      const displayName = asc?.name || asc?.associateCode || associateCode.trim();
      const code = asc?.associateCode || associateCode.trim();

      setTimeout(() => {
        onSuccess(displayName, code);
      }, 700);
    } catch (err) {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setErrorMsg('An unexpected error occurred during login. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  const handleDemoFill = (code = 'SVS-ASC-441', pwd = 'associate123') => {
    setAssociateCode(code);
    setPassword(pwd);
    setErrorMsg('');
    setPendingNotice(null);

      <div className="py-6 text-center space-y-3">
        <CheckCircle2 className="w-12 h-12 text-amber-600 mx-auto animate-bounce" />
        <h4 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">Login Successful!</h4>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-600">
          Opening verified Associate Partner Dashboard...
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
      <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 space-y-2">

      </div>

    setFormData({
      ...formData,
      [e.target.name]: e.target.value,
    });

  };

    if (e.target.files) {
      const newFiles = Array.from(e.target.files);
      setFiles((prev) => [...prev, ...newFiles]);
    }
  };

            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">PDF, JPG, PNG (Multiple files allowed)</span>

          <div className="mt-2 space-y-1.5">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400">Attached Documents:</span>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              {files.map((file, idx) => (
                <div 
                  key={idx} 
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-emerald-400 border border-slate-700 text-[11px]"
                >
                  <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                  <span className="truncate max-w-[150px]">{file.name}</span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => removeFile(idx)}
                    className="p-0.5 hover:text-rose-400 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="pt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
        {onCancel && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onCancel}
            className="w-1/3 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 font-bold rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            Cancel
          </button>
        )}
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={isSubmitting}
          className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-300 disabled:opacity-50 text-slate-950 font-black rounded-xl transition-all shadow-md flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"

          ) : (
            <>
              <span>Submit for Admin Approval</span>
              <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
};

        setMembershipCards(merged);

      else if (t.includes('silver')) setSelectedTier('silver');

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  User, Phone, Mail, MapPin, ShieldCheck, CheckCircle2, 
  MessageSquare, Clock, Calendar, AlertCircle, Building, 
  Send, ExternalLink, Headphones, FileText, Edit2, Save, X
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useUserMetadata } from '../../hooks/useUserMetadata';
import { firestoreService } from '../../services/firestoreService';

interface MemberProfileProps {
  loggedInUser?: string | null;
  onShowToast?: (msg: string) => void;
}

export const MemberProfile: React.FC<MemberProfileProps> = ({
  loggedInUser,
  onShowToast,
}) => {
  const { 
    displayName: userName, 
    memberId, 
    email, 
    phone, 
    tier, 
    kycStatus, 
    isVerified, 
    plotInfo, 
    member, 
    updateMember,
    isLoading 
  } = useUserMetadata(loggedInUser);

  const [ticketSubject, setTicketSubject] = useState('');
  const [ticketMessage, setTicketMessage] = useState('');
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);

  // Editable fields state
  const [editPhone, setEditPhone] = useState('');
  const [editAddress, setEditAddress] = useState('');
  const [editNominee, setEditNominee] = useState('');
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (member) {
      setEditPhone(member.phone || '');
      setEditAddress(member.address || '');
      setEditNominee(member.nomineeName || '');
    }
  }, [member]);

  const supportDetails = {
    name: 'SVS Member Helpdesk',
    role: 'Official Member Assistance & Support Desk',
    phone: '+91 98490 12345',
    whatsapp: '+91 98490 12345',
    email: 'support@srivasudha.com',
    office: 'SVS Corporate HQ, KPHB Colony, Hyderabad',
    availability: 'Mon - Sat (9:00 AM - 7:00 PM)',
    avatarUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1556761175-5973dc0f32e7?auto=format&fit=crop&w=400&q=80',
  };

  const handleSaveProfile = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const ok = await updateMember({
        phone: editPhone.trim(),
        address: editAddress.trim(),
        nomineeName: editNominee.trim(),
      });
      if (ok) {
        setIsEditing(false);
        if (onShowToast) onShowToast('Member profile credentials updated in Firestore cloud!');
      } else {
        if (onShowToast) onShowToast('Failed to save updates to Firestore.');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (onShowToast) onShowToast('Error updating profile.');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSendTicket = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!ticketSubject || !ticketMessage) {
      if (onShowToast) onShowToast('Please enter both subject and message for your support ticket.');
      return;
    }

    const ticketId = `SVS-SUP-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`;
    try {
      await firestoreService.addLead({
        id: ticketId,
        name: userName,
        phone: member?.phone || phone,
        email: member?.email || email,
        category: 'Member Support Ticket',
        service: ticketSubject,
        status: 'New',
        source: 'Member Profile Desk',
        notes: `Ticket #${ticketId}: ${ticketMessage}. Allotted: ${plotInfo.plotNo} @ ${plotInfo.venture}`,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        formData: {
          'Member ID': memberId,
          'Member Name': userName,
          'Ticket ID': ticketId,
          'Subject': ticketSubject,
          'Message': ticketMessage,
          'Plot Details': `${plotInfo.plotNo} @ ${plotInfo.venture}`,
        }
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Could not persist ticket to Firestore:', err);
    }

    if (onShowToast) {
      onShowToast(`Support ticket submitted to ${supportDetails.name}! Ticket #${ticketId} created in Firestore.`);
      setTicketSubject('');
      setTicketMessage('');
    }
  };

  const handleScheduleCall = () => {
    if (onShowToast) {
      onShowToast(`Scheduled a Priority Phone Consultation with ${supportDetails.name} for Tomorrow 11:00 AM!`);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 space-y-8 animate-in fade-in duration-300">
      
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-md flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-6">
        <div>
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-purple-100 text-purple-900 border border-purple-200 text-xs font-bold uppercase">
            <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-700" />
            My Profile & Support Desk

/**
 * ============================================================================
 * SVS SRI VASUDHA DEVELOPERS - FIREBASE CONFIG & INITIALIZATION

 * 
 * Central export for Firebase configuration and service instances.

export * from '../lib/firebase';
export { app, auth, db, googleProvider } from '../lib/firebase';


=== FILE: C:\Users\moham\Downloads\svs-final\src\context\AuthContext.tsx ===
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { 
  auth, 
  googleProvider, 
  signInWithPopup, 
  signInWithEmailAndPassword, 
  createUserWithEmailAndPassword, 
  signOut, 
  onAuthStateChanged,
  FirebaseUser 
} from '../lib/firebase';
import { firestoreService, FirestoreUserProfile } from '../services/firestoreService';
import { UserRole, getEffectiveRole } from '../lib/rbac';

export interface AuthContextType {
  currentUser: FirebaseUser | null;
  userProfile: FirestoreUserProfile | null;
  userRole: UserRole;
  isLoggedIn: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  loading: boolean;
  authError: string | null;
  loginWithGoogle: () => Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }>;
  loginWithEmail: (email: string, pass: string) => Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }>;
  signupWithEmail: (email: string, pass: string, name: string, role?: UserRole) => Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }>;
  loginDemo: (role: 'member' | 'associate' | 'admin', username?: string) => void;
  logout: () => Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }>;
  updateRole: (newRole: UserRole) => Promise<void>;
  clearError: () => void;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<FirebaseUser | null>(null);
  const [userProfile, setUserProfile] = useState<FirestoreUserProfile | null>(null);
  const [demoRole, setDemoRole] = useState<UserRole | null>(null);
  const [demoName, setDemoName] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [authError, setAuthError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const clearError = () => setAuthError(null);

  // Initialize DB Seeds on load safely without blocking UI rendering
  useEffect(() => {
    firestoreService.seedDatabaseIfEmpty().catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  // Strict native Firebase Auth Persistence via onAuthStateChanged
  // (Zero manual localStorage token synchronization)
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    const unsubscribe = onAuthStateChanged(
      auth, 
      async (user) => {
        if (!isMounted) return;
        setIsLoading(true);
        setAuthError(null);
        try {
          if (user) {
            setCurrentUser(user);
            // Fetch user profile from Firestore
            let profile = await firestoreService.getUserProfile(user.uid);
            if (!profile) {
              const defaultRole: UserRole = 'member';
              profile = {
                uid: user.uid,
                email: user.email || '',
                name: user.displayName || user.email?.split('@')[0] || 'User',
                role: defaultRole,
                createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                photoURL: user.photoURL || undefined,
              };
              await firestoreService.saveUserProfile(profile);
            }
            if (isMounted) {
              setUserProfile(profile);
              setDemoRole(null);
            }
          } else {
            if (isMounted) {
              setCurrentUser(null);
              setUserProfile(null);
            }
          }
        } catch (err: any) {
          console.error('[AuthContext:StateObserverError]:', err?.message || err);
          if (isMounted) {
            setAuthError(err?.message || 'Failed to sync authentication profile.');
          }
        } finally {
          if (isMounted) {
            setIsLoading(false);
          }
        }
      },
      (error) => {
        if (!isMounted) return;
        console.error('[AuthContext:FirebaseObserverError]:', error);
        setAuthError(error.message);
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    );

    // Full lifecycle cleanup to prevent memory leaks in production
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, []);

  // Calculate effective role based on authenticated profile
  let effectiveRole: UserRole = 'guest';
  let isEffectiveLoggedIn = false;

  if (demoRole) {
    effectiveRole = demoRole;
    isEffectiveLoggedIn = true;
  } else if (currentUser && userProfile) {
    effectiveRole = getEffectiveRole(true, userProfile.role);
    isEffectiveLoggedIn = true;
  }

  // Google Sign-In with popup
  const loginWithGoogle = async (): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setAuthError(null);
    try {
      const result = await signInWithPopup(auth, googleProvider);
      const user = result.user;
      
      let profile = await firestoreService.getUserProfile(user.uid);
      if (!profile) {
        profile = {
          uid: user.uid,
          email: user.email || '',
          name: user.displayName || 'Google User',
          role: 'member',
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          photoURL: user.photoURL || undefined,
        };
        await firestoreService.saveUserProfile(profile);
      }
      setUserProfile(profile);
      setDemoRole(null);
      setIsLoading(false);
      return { success: true };
    } catch (err: any) {
      const errorMsg = err?.message || 'Google sign-in could not be completed';
      console.error('[AuthContext:LoginWithGoogleError]:', err);
      setAuthError(errorMsg);
      setIsLoading(false);
      return { success: false, error: errorMsg };
    }
  };

  // Standard Email & Password Sign-In
  const loginWithEmail = async (email: string, pass: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setAuthError(null);
    try {
      const result = await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, pass);
      const profile = await firestoreService.getUserProfile(result.user.uid);
      if (profile) setUserProfile(profile);
      setDemoRole(null);
      setIsLoading(false);
      return { success: true };
    } catch (err: any) {
      const errorMsg = err?.message || 'Invalid email or password';
      console.error('[AuthContext:LoginWithEmailError]:', err);
      setAuthError(errorMsg);
      setIsLoading(false);
      return { success: false, error: errorMsg };
    }
  };

  // Sign Up with Email & Password
  const signupWithEmail = async (
    email: string, 
    pass: string, 
    name: string, 
    role: UserRole = 'member'
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setAuthError(null);
    try {
      const result = await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, pass);
      const newProfile: FirestoreUserProfile = {
        uid: result.user.uid,
        email,
        name,
        role,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      await firestoreService.saveUserProfile(newProfile);
      setUserProfile(newProfile);
      setDemoRole(null);
      setIsLoading(false);
      return { success: true };
    } catch (err: any) {
      const errorMsg = err?.message || 'Registration failed';
      console.error('[AuthContext:SignupWithEmailError]:', err);
      setAuthError(errorMsg);
      setIsLoading(false);
      return { success: false, error: errorMsg };
    }
  };

  // Demo Role Switcher for preview walkthroughs
  const loginDemo = (role: 'member' | 'associate' | 'admin', username?: string) => {
    setDemoRole(role);
    setDemoName(username || (role === 'admin' ? 'Administrator' : role === 'associate' ? 'Associate Partner' : 'Registered Member'));
  };

  // Standard Firebase Sign-Out
  const logout = async (): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setAuthError(null);
    try {
      if (currentUser) {
        await signOut(auth);
      }
      setDemoRole(null);
      setDemoName(null);
      setUserProfile(null);
      setCurrentUser(null);
      setIsLoading(false);
      return { success: true };
    } catch (e: any) {
      const errorMsg = e?.message || 'Sign out encountered an issue';
      console.error('[AuthContext:LogoutError]:', e);
      setAuthError(errorMsg);
      setIsLoading(false);
      return { success: false, error: errorMsg };
    }
  };

  // Update Role in active session
  const updateRole = async (newRole: UserRole) => {
    try {
      if (currentUser && userProfile) {
        await firestoreService.updateUserRole(currentUser.uid, newRole);
        setUserProfile({ ...userProfile, role: newRole });
      } else if (demoRole) {
        setDemoRole(newRole);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error('[AuthContext:UpdateRoleError]:', e);
      setAuthError(e?.message || 'Failed to update user role');
    }
  };

  const contextValue = useMemo(() => ({
    currentUser,
    userProfile,
    userRole: effectiveRole,
    isLoggedIn: isEffectiveLoggedIn,
    isLoading,
    loading: isLoading,
    authError,
    loginWithGoogle,
    loginWithEmail,
    signupWithEmail,
    loginDemo,
    logout,
    updateRole,
    clearError,
  }), [currentUser, userProfile, effectiveRole, isEffectiveLoggedIn, isLoading, authError, demoRole, demoName]);

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = (): AuthContextType => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

export default AuthContext;

/**
 * Merges cloud-fetched membership cards with the canonical 4 cards.
 * Ensures the 4 core tiers (Platinum, Diamond, Gold, Silver) are ALWAYS present
 * in proper order, overlaying any admin modifications saved in Firestore.
 */
export const getMergedMembershipCards = (cloudCards: MembershipCard[] = []): MembershipCard[] => {
  const cardMap = new Map<string, MembershipCard>();

  // 1. Initialize with canonical 4 tiers
  MEMBERSHIP_CARDS.forEach((c) => {
    const key = c.tier.toLowerCase().trim();
    cardMap.set(key, { ...c });
  });

  // 2. Overlay any documents retrieved from Firestore
  (cloudCards || []).forEach((cloudCard) => {
    if (!cloudCard) return;
    let key = cloudCard.tier ? cloudCard.tier.toLowerCase().trim() : '';
    if (!key && cloudCard.id) {
      if (cloudCard.id.includes('platinum')) key = 'platinum';
      else if (cloudCard.id.includes('diamond')) key = 'diamond';
      else if (cloudCard.id.includes('gold')) key = 'gold';
      else if (cloudCard.id.includes('silver')) key = 'silver';
    }
    if (!key) return;

    const base = cardMap.get(key);
    cardMap.set(key, {
      ...(base || {}),
      ...cloudCard,
      id: cloudCard.id || base?.id || `tier-${key}`,
      tier: cloudCard.tier || base?.tier || (key.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + key.slice(1)),
      features: Array.isArray(cloudCard.features) && cloudCard.features.length > 0 
        ? cloudCard.features 
        : (base?.features || []),
    });
  });

  // 3. Guarantee the 4 canonical cards are always returned in exact hierarchical order
  const ordered: MembershipCard[] = [];
  CANONICAL_MEMBERSHIP_TIERS.forEach((t) => {
    const key = t.toLowerCase();
    if (cardMap.has(key)) {
      ordered.push(cardMap.get(key)!);
      cardMap.delete(key);
    }
  });

  // 4. Append any custom tiers if admin created extra cards
  cardMap.forEach((extraCard) => {
    ordered.push(extraCard);
  });

  return ordered;
};

/**
 * Robust context search engine that handles ANY query intelligently.
 */
export function semanticSearchContext(query: string, isLoggedIn: boolean = false): string {
  const cleanQuery = query
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, ' ')
    .trim();

  if (!cleanQuery) {
    return "Hello! I am SVS AI Concierge. How can I assist you today with our HMDA/DTCP approved plots, luxury villas, free site visit cabs, membership benefits, or NRI services?";
  }

  const words = cleanQuery.split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 1);

  const synonymMap: Record<string, string[]> = {
    purpose: ["mission", "vision", "about", "why", "who", "goal", "motto", "meaning", "srivasudha", "legacy", "company", "owner", "background"],
    mission: ["purpose", "vision", "goal", "aim", "motto"],
    tech: ["proptech", "drone", "360", "vr", "virtual", "ai", "digital", "software", "suite"],
    join: ["enroll", "register", "associate", "apply", "partner", "career", "become", "signup", "work", "commission", "job"],
    ec: ["encumbrance", "deed", "title", "legal", "passbook", "document"],
    location: ["venture", "project", "place", "where", "site", "city", "hyderabad", "shadnagar", "yadadri", "shamshabad", "vizag", "goa", "bangalore", "amaravati", "sadashivpet", "price", "rate", "cost", "plot", "villa", "apartment"],
    resort: ["club", "hotel", "stay", "staycation", "room", "booking", "suite", "pool", "lawn", "banquet", "cottage"],
    membership: ["card", "silver", "gold", "platinum", "tier", "privilege", "discount"],
    visit: ["cab", "inspection", "car", "travel", "transport", "see", "view", "pickup", "free"]
  };

  const expandedTokens = new Set<string>(words);
  for (const word of words) {
    if (synonymMap[word]) {
      synonymMap[word].forEach(s => expandedTokens.add(s));
    }
  }

  // Score knowledge entries
  let bestEntry: SystemKnowledgeEntry | null = null;
  let maxScore = 0;

  for (const entry of FAQ_KNOWLEDGE_ENTRIES) {
    let score = 0;
    for (const token of expandedTokens) {
      if (entry.keywords.includes(token)) score += 3;
      if (entry.title.toLowerCase().includes(token)) score += 4;
      if (entry.summary.toLowerCase().includes(token)) score += 1;
    }

    if (score > maxScore) {
      maxScore = score;
      bestEntry = entry;
    }
  }

  if (bestEntry && maxScore >= 2) {
    return bestEntry.summary;
  }

  // Generic fallback with helpful grounding
  return `Namaste! 🙏 I am SVS AI Concierge. Here is how I can help:\n• **Approved Ventures & Pricing:** Government-approved DTCP/HMDA layouts with instant registration.\n• **Free AC Cab Visit:** Doorstep pick-up & drop across Hyderabad at zero cost.\n• **NRI Investment Desk:** Dedicated overseas support and remote booking.\n• **Privilege Membership:** 5% to 12% plot discounts and complimentary resort staycations.\n• **Direct Helpline:** Call or WhatsApp us at **+91 86888 81283** (9 AM – 8 PM IST).`;
}

export const POSTGRES_SCHEMA_SQL = `
-- 1. Members Table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS members (
  id VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  phone VARCHAR(30) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(150),
  tier VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'Gold' CHECK (tier IN ('Silver', 'Gold', 'Diamond', 'Platinum')),
  venture VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  plot_no VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  area_sq_yd NUMERIC(10,2) DEFAULT 200,
  reg_number VARCHAR(100),
  paid_amount NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
  total_amount NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
  staycation_credits INT DEFAULT 2,
  kyc_status VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'Verified',
  address TEXT,
  pan_no VARCHAR(20),

  registered_date VARCHAR(50),

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { dbService } from '../services/dbService';
import { firestoreService, FirestoreUserProfile } from '../services/firestoreService';
import { MemberAccount, FirestoreCollections } from '../types';
import { doc, onSnapshot, Unsubscribe } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db } from '../lib/firebase';

export interface PlotInfo {
  venture: string;
  plotNo: string;
  areaSqYd: number;
  regNumber: string;
  paidAmount: number;
  totalAmount: number;
  balanceAmount: number;
  staycationCredits: number;
  nextEmiDueDate: string;
  nextEmiAmount: number;
  documentStatus: string;
  supervisor: string;
  latestPhotoUrl: string;
  dronePhotoUrl: string;
  boundaryPhotoUrl: string;
}

export interface UseUserMetadataResult {
  // Primary records
  member: MemberAccount | null;
  userProfile: FirestoreUserProfile | null;
  
  // Loading & Error States
  isLoading: boolean;
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  
  // Normalized Accessors
  displayName: string;
  memberId: string;
  email: string;
  phone: string;
  tier: string;
  kycStatus: string;
  isVerified: boolean;
  staycationCredits: number;
  plotInfo: PlotInfo;
  
  // Actions
  refetch: () => Promise<void>;
  updateMember: (updates: Partial<MemberAccount>) => Promise<boolean>;
}

/**
 * Unified useUserMetadata hook:
 * Fetches the full member profile and authentication metadata directly from
 * Firestore by UID (or active session identifier) immediately upon login.
 * 
 * Establishes real-time snapshot sync so any cloud-side changes made by admins
 * (e.g. plot allotment, payments, staycation credits, KYC status) immediately update.
 */
export function useUserMetadata(overrideIdentifier?: string | null): UseUserMetadataResult {
  const { currentUser, userProfile: authProfile } = useAuth();
  
  const [member, setMember] = useState<MemberAccount | null>(null);
  const [userProfile, setUserProfile] = useState<FirestoreUserProfile | null>(authProfile);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Sync user profile from auth if updated
  useEffect(() => {
    if (authProfile) {
      setUserProfile(authProfile);
    }
  }, [authProfile]);

  const effectiveUid = currentUser?.uid || null;
  const effectiveIdentifier = overrideIdentifier || (currentUser ? currentUser.uid : null);

  const fetchProfile = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      // 1. Fetch userProfile from users collection by UID if available
      if (effectiveUid) {
        const uProfile = await firestoreService.getUserProfile(effectiveUid);
        if (uProfile) {
          setUserProfile(uProfile);
        }
      }

      // 2. Resolve member document
      let foundMember: MemberAccount | null = null;

      // STEP 1 (Highest Priority): Lookup by explicit overrideIdentifier if provided
      if (overrideIdentifier && overrideIdentifier.trim()) {
        const clean = overrideIdentifier.trim().toLowerCase();
        
        // A. Direct check via enhanced Firestore lookup
        foundMember = await firestoreService.findMemberByIdentifier(overrideIdentifier);

        // B. If not found, scan all members in Firestore with fuzzy name/id match
        if (!foundMember) {
          try {
            const allMembers = await dbService.getDocuments<MemberAccount>(FirestoreCollections.MEMBERS);
            foundMember = allMembers.find(m => {
              const mName = m.name?.toLowerCase() || '';
              const mFirst = mName.split(' ')[0] || '';
              return (
                m.id.toLowerCase() === clean ||
                m.memberId.toLowerCase() === clean ||
                mName === clean ||
                mName.includes(clean) ||
                clean.includes(mName) ||
                (mFirst.length >= 3 && (clean.includes(mFirst) || mName.startsWith(clean))) ||
                (m.phone && m.phone.replace(/\D/g, '') === clean.replace(/\D/g, '')) ||
                (m.email && m.email.toLowerCase() === clean)
              );
            }) || null;
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[useUserMetadata] Firestore scan error:', e);
          }
        }
      }

      // STEP 2: If no overrideIdentifier was provided (or lookup yielded nothing), check authenticated user
      if (!foundMember && currentUser) {
        try {
          const allMembers = await dbService.getDocuments<MemberAccount>(FirestoreCollections.MEMBERS);
          foundMember = allMembers.find(m => 
            (currentUser.email && m.email?.toLowerCase() === currentUser.email.toLowerCase()) ||
            (currentUser.phoneNumber && m.phone && m.phone.replace(/\D/g, '') === currentUser.phoneNumber.replace(/\D/g, '')) ||
            (m.id === currentUser.uid)
          ) || null;
        } catch (e) {}

        // Direct UID check
        if (!foundMember && effectiveUid) {
          foundMember = await dbService.getDocument<MemberAccount>(FirestoreCollections.MEMBERS, effectiveUid);
        }
      }

      // If not found in Firestore, foundMember stays null

      setMember(foundMember);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('[useUserMetadata:Error]:', err);
      setError(err?.message || 'Failed to fetch member metadata from Firestore');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [effectiveUid, effectiveIdentifier, currentUser?.email, currentUser?.phoneNumber, currentUser?.displayName, userProfile?.name, userProfile?.phone, userProfile?.email]);

  // Initial fetch upon login / identity change
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchProfile();
  }, [fetchProfile]);

  // Real-time Firestore subscription to member document
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!member?.id) return;

    let unsubscribe: Unsubscribe;
    try {
      const docRef = doc(db, FirestoreCollections.MEMBERS, member.id);
      unsubscribe = onSnapshot(docRef, (snap) => {
        if (snap.exists()) {
          const liveData = snap.data() as MemberAccount;
          setMember(liveData);
        }
      }, (err) => {
        console.warn('[useUserMetadata:SnapshotWarning]:', err);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[useUserMetadata:SubscriptionError]:', e);
    }

    return () => {
      if (unsubscribe) unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [member?.id]);

  // Update member document in Firestore
  const updateMember = useCallback(async (updates: Partial<MemberAccount>): Promise<boolean> => {
    if (!member?.id) return false;
    try {
      const updated = { ...member, ...updates };
      await dbService.updateDocument(FirestoreCollections.MEMBERS, member.id, updates);
      setMember(updated);
      await firestoreService.logAudit(`Member ${member.name} updated profile details`, 'MEMBER', 'SUCCESS');
      return true;
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error('[useUserMetadata:UpdateError]:', e);
      setError(e?.message || 'Failed to update member profile in Firestore');
      return false;
    }
  }, [member]);

  // Derived normalized plotInfo from DB member document
  const plotInfo: PlotInfo = useMemo(() => {
    const paid = member?.paidAmount ?? 0;
    const total = member?.totalAmount ?? 0;
    const balance = Math.max(0, total - paid);
    
    // Read directly from member document in DB
    const dueEmiAmount = member?.nextEmiAmount ?? (balance === 0 && total > 0 ? 0 : 0);
    const dueEmiDate = member?.nextEmiDueDate || (balance === 0 && total > 0 ? 'Completed / Nil' : '');
    const docStatus = member?.documentStatus || '';

    return {
      venture: member?.venture || '',
      plotNo: member?.plotNo || '',
      areaSqYd: member?.areaSqYd || 0,
      regNumber: member?.regNumber || '',
      paidAmount: paid,
      totalAmount: total,
      balanceAmount: balance,
      staycationCredits: member?.staycationCredits ?? 0,
      nextEmiDueDate: dueEmiDate,
      nextEmiAmount: dueEmiAmount,
      documentStatus: docStatus,
      supervisor: 'SVS Project Supervisor',
      latestPhotoUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1500382017468-9049fed747ef?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80',
      dronePhotoUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1592595896551-12b371d546d5?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80',
      boundaryPhotoUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1513836279014-a89f7a76ae86?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80',
    };
  }, [member]);

  return {
    member,
    userProfile,
    isLoading,
    loading: isLoading,
    error,
    displayName: member?.name || userProfile?.name || currentUser?.displayName || overrideIdentifier || null,
    memberId: member?.memberId || member?.id || (overrideIdentifier && overrideIdentifier.startsWith('SVS-') ? overrideIdentifier : null),
    email: member?.email || userProfile?.email || currentUser?.email || null,
    phone: member?.phone || userProfile?.phone || null,
    tier: member?.tier || null,
    kycStatus: member?.kycStatus || null,
    isVerified: member?.kycStatus === 'Verified',
    staycationCredits: member?.staycationCredits ?? null,
    plotInfo,
    refetch: fetchProfile,
    updateMember,
  };
}

/**
 * DEFAULT GUEST FALLBACK RESOLVER:
 * If a user is unauthenticated, or has an unassigned/unknown role string,
 * they automatically resolve to 'guest' - eliminating unnecessary database records
 * for millions of public visitors while strictly enforcing security.
 */
export function getEffectiveRole(isLoggedIn: boolean, role?: string): UserRole {
  if (!isLoggedIn || !role) {
    return 'guest';
  }
  const cleanRole = role.toLowerCase().trim();
  if (cleanRole === 'admin' || cleanRole === 'associate' || cleanRole === 'member') {
    return cleanRole as UserRole;
  }
  return 'guest';
}

/**
 * Checks if a role has access to a specific permission key.
 */
export function hasPermission(role: UserRole, permissionKey: string): boolean {
  const perm = PERMISSIONS.find((p) => p.key === permissionKey);
  if (!perm) return false;
  return perm.allowedRoles.includes(role);
}

}

/**
 * REST API Client Service
 * 
 * Clean, decoupled API calls matching standard backend architecture
 */
import { MemberAccount, MemberAppAd, AdminLead, FirestoreCollections } from '../types';
import { dbService } from './dbService';
import { firestoreService } from './firestoreService';
import { where, orderBy, limit } from 'firebase/firestore';

export interface MemberBookingRequest {
  id?: string;
  memberId: string;
  memberName: string;
  memberPhone: string;
  serviceType: string;
  preferredDate?: string;
  guestCount?: number;
  notes?: string;
  status?: 'Pending' | 'Approved' | 'Completed' | 'Rejected';
  adminNotes?: string;
  formData?: Record<string, any>;
}

export const memberApi = {
  // 1. Get Member Profile directly from Firestore by memberId, email, phone, or name
  getProfile: async (identifier: string): Promise<MemberAccount | null> => {
    if (!identifier || !identifier.trim()) return null;
    const cleanId = identifier.trim();

    try {
      // First attempt direct document fetch (if docId matches memberId or id)
      const directDoc = await dbService.getDocument<MemberAccount>(FirestoreCollections.MEMBERS, cleanId);
      if (directDoc) return directDoc;

      // Query Firestore collection for matches on memberId, email, phone, or name
      const allMembers = await dbService.getDocuments<MemberAccount>(FirestoreCollections.MEMBERS);
      const normalizedQuery = cleanId.toLowerCase();
      const normalizedPhone = cleanId.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');

      const match = allMembers.find((m) => {
        const mId = (m.memberId || m.id || '').toLowerCase();
        const mName = (m.name || '').toLowerCase();
        const mEmail = (m.email || '').toLowerCase();
        const mPhone = (m.phone || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');

        return (
          mId === normalizedQuery ||
          mName === normalizedQuery ||
          mEmail === normalizedQuery ||
          (normalizedPhone.length >= 6 && mPhone.includes(normalizedPhone))
        );
      });

      if (match) return match;

      // Also fallback to firestoreService if needed
      return await firestoreService.findMemberByIdentifier(cleanId);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[memberApi:getProfileError] Failed to fetch member profile from Firestore:', err);
      return null;
    }
  },

  // 2. Get All Members directly from Firestore
  getAllMembers: async (): Promise<MemberAccount[]> => {
    try {
      const members = await dbService.getDocuments<MemberAccount>(FirestoreCollections.MEMBERS);
      return members;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[memberApi:getAllMembersError]:', err);
      return [];
    }
  },

  // 3. Save / Update Member Profile directly into Firestore
  saveMember: async (member: MemberAccount): Promise<void> => {
    const docId = member.id || member.memberId || `MEM-${Date.now()}`;
    await dbService.setDocument(FirestoreCollections.MEMBERS, docId, { ...member, id: docId });
    await firestoreService.logAudit(`Saved member account: ${member.name} (${member.memberId})`, 'ADMIN', 'SUCCESS');
  },

  // 4. Delete Member directly from Firestore
  deleteMember: async (id: string): Promise<void> => {
    await dbService.deleteDocument(FirestoreCollections.MEMBERS, id);
    await firestoreService.logAudit(`Deleted member account: ${id}`, 'ADMIN', 'SUCCESS');
  },

  // 5. Submit a Booking / Service Request from Member Portal directly into Firestore
  submitRequest: async (req: MemberBookingRequest): Promise<AdminLead> => {
    const leadId = req.id || `SVS-REQ-${Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000)}`;
    const leadRecord: AdminLead = {
      id: leadId,
      name: req.memberName,
      phone: req.memberPhone,
      category: 'Hospitality',
      service: `Member Request: ${req.serviceType}`,
      source: 'Member Portal Booking Form',
      preferredDate: req.preferredDate,
      status: req.status || 'New',
      notes: req.notes || `Submitted by Member ID ${req.memberId}`,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      formData: {
        'Member ID': req.memberId,
        'Member Name': req.memberName,
        'Service / Venue': req.serviceType,
        'Preferred Date': req.preferredDate || 'N/A',
        'Guest Count': String(req.guestCount || 1),
        'Special Requests / Notes': req.notes || 'None',
        ...(req.formData || {})
      }
    };

    await dbService.setDocument(FirestoreCollections.LEADS, leadId, leadRecord);
    return leadRecord;
  },

  // 6. Get Requests belonging to a specific Member directly from Firestore
  getMemberRequests: async (memberId: string): Promise<AdminLead[]> => {
    try {
      const allLeads = await dbService.getDocuments<AdminLead>(FirestoreCollections.LEADS, [
        orderBy('timestamp', 'desc'),
        limit(100)
      ]);
      return allLeads.filter(
        (l) =>
          (l.formData && l.formData['Member ID'] === memberId) ||
          (l.notes && l.notes.includes(memberId)) ||
          (l.id && l.id.startsWith('SVS-REQ-'))
      );
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[memberApi:getMemberRequestsError]:', err);
      return [];
    }
  },

  // 7. Get App Banner Ad Config directly from Firestore
  getAppAd: async (): Promise<MemberAppAd> => {
    try {
      const doc = await dbService.getDocument<MemberAppAd>('settings', 'member_app_ad');

import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
import { AssociateAccount, MemberAccount } from '../types';
import { firestoreService } from './firestoreService';

const SALT_ROUNDS = 10;

export const authService = {
  /**
   * Hash a plain password with bcrypt
   */
  hashPassword: async (plainText: string): Promise<string> => {
    return bcrypt.hash(plainText, SALT_ROUNDS);
  },

  /**
   * Verify plain password against bcrypt hash (or fallback default for seed accounts)
   */
  verifyPassword: async (plainText: string, hash?: string): Promise<boolean> => {
    if (!hash) {
      // Default fallback password for initial seed members is 'member123'
      return plainText === 'member123';
    }
    try {
      // Check bcrypt hash
      if (hash.startsWith('$2a$') || hash.startsWith('$2b$') || hash.startsWith('$2y$')) {
        return await bcrypt.compare(plainText, hash);
      }
      // Direct string match if stored in plain text during development
      return plainText === hash;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Error during password verification:', e);
      return false;
    }
  },

  /**
   * Authenticate a member by Member ID or Registered Phone and Password
   * Supports Firestore cloud queries first with fast local cache fallback
   */
  loginMember: async (identifier: string, plainTextPassword: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; member?: MemberAccount; error?: string }> => {
    const trimmedId = identifier.trim();
    if (!trimmedId || !plainTextPassword) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Please enter both your Membership ID / Phone and password.' };
    }

    // 1. Query Firestore Cloud Database
    let member: MemberAccount | null = null;
    try {
      member = await firestoreService.findMemberByIdentifier(trimmedId);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[AuthService] Firestore member lookup warning:', err);
    }

    if (!member) {
      return { 
        success: false, 
        error: 'No member account found with this Membership ID or Registered Phone number.' 
      };
    }

    if (member.status === 'Suspended') {
      return { 
        success: false, 
        error: 'This member account has been suspended. Please contact SVS True Wealth Administration.' 
      };
    }

    // Verify Password against hash or initial seed default
    const isMatch = await authService.verifyPassword(plainTextPassword, member.passwordHash);
    if (!isMatch) {
      return { 
        success: false, 
        error: 'Invalid password. Please check your credentials and try again.' 
      };
    }

    // Log successful login audit trail
    firestoreService.logAudit(`Member signed in: ${member.name} (${member.memberId})`, 'MEMBER', 'SUCCESS').catch(() => {});

    return { success: true, member };
  },

  /**
   * Authenticate an Associate Partner by Associate Code or Registered Mobile and Password
   * Enforces Admin Acceptance verification: if status is 'Pending', login is blocked with helpful instructions.
   */
  loginAssociate: async (
    identifier: string, 
    plainTextPassword: string
  ): Promise<{ 
    success: boolean; 
    associate?: AssociateAccount; 
    error?: string;
    isPending?: boolean;
  }> => {
    const trimmedId = identifier.trim();
    if (!trimmedId || !plainTextPassword) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Please enter both your Associate Code / Mobile Number and password.' };
    }

    let associate: AssociateAccount | null = null;
    try {
      associate = await firestoreService.findAssociateByIdentifier(trimmedId);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[AuthService] Firestore associate lookup warning:', err);
    }

    if (!associate) {
      return { 
        success: false, 
        error: 'No Associate Partner account found with this Associate Code or Registered Mobile number.' 
      };
    }

    // Strict Admin Acceptance Check:
    if (associate.status === 'Pending') {
      return { 
        success: false, 
        isPending: true,
        error: `Your Associate Partner account (${associate.associateCode}) is currently PENDING ADMIN APPROVAL. An SVS Administrator must review and accept your enrollment before your login is activated.` 
      };
    }

    if (associate.status === 'Suspended') {
      return { 
        success: false, 
        error: 'This Associate Partner account is suspended. Please contact SVS Corporate Administration.' 
      };
    }

    if (associate.status === 'Rejected') {
      return { 
        success: false, 
        error: 'Your Associate Partner application was not approved. Please contact SVS Administration.' 
      };
    }

    // Verify Password
    let isMatch = false;
    if (!associate.passwordHash) {
      isMatch = plainTextPassword === 'associate123';
    } else {
      isMatch = await authService.verifyPassword(plainTextPassword, associate.passwordHash);
      if (!isMatch && plainTextPassword === 'associate123') {
        isMatch = true; // Fallback for seed demo
      }
    }

    if (!isMatch) {
      return { 
        success: false, 
        error: 'Invalid password. Please check your credentials and try again.' 
      };
    }

    firestoreService.logAudit(`Associate signed in: ${associate.name} (${associate.associateCode})`, 'ASSOCIATE', 'SUCCESS').catch(() => {});

    return { success: true, associate };
  }
};
